# `instanceOfSchema`

Suggests using Schema.is instead of instanceof for Effect Schema types

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Category | Effect-native |
| Default severity | `off` |
| Fixable | Yes |
| Effect versions | v3, v4 |
| Diagnostic codes | `TS377042` |
| Language Service name | `instanceOfSchema` |
| Oxlint name | `effecttsgo/instance-of-schema` |

## Preview

```ts
import { Schema } from "effect"

class User extends Schema.Class<User>("User")({ name: Schema.String }) {}
declare const value: unknown
export const preview = value instanceof User
/**
                       ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ effecttsgo(instance-of-schema): This code uses `instanceof` with an Effect Schema type. `Schema.is` is the schema-aware runtime check for this case.
*/
```

See the [Language Service setup guide](../../README.md#installation) for installation instructions.

```jsonc
{
  "$schema": "./node_modules/@effect/tsgo/schema.json",
  "compilerOptions": {
    "plugins": [
      {
        "name": "@effect/language-service",
        "diagnosticSeverity": {
          "instanceOfSchema": "warning"
        }
      }
    ]
  }
}
```
